about_the_game:
The complete soundtrack to Upwards, Rain!, composed in a few short bursts of work over the span of a couple weeks for a Studio Élan internal game jam in September 2024. Improvements and additions have been made for the complete Steam release.

The "turn brain off and emit the good tunes" approach in action.
